name: Hansen Technologies Limited
summary: Hansen Technologies Limited engages in the development, implementation, and support of billing and customer information systems. The company operates through Energy & Utilities, and Communications & Media segment. It offers Hansen Suite, a set of software applications for the energy, utilities, and communications sector; and consulting services for customers the primarily operates in electricity, gas, and water, as well as telecommunications and pay-TV.
